what.text: This page follows refugees from Iraq living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 128544 Iraqi refugees in Germany, 47.5% of all refugees from Iraq.
Germany is the largest host of Iraqi refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Türkiye and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iraq in every year from 2004 to 2025, at war level in many of them.
The government's opponents it records include the al-Mahdi Army, Ansar al-Islam, IS and RJF.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 72697 refugees and was lower in 2007.
The figure rose again and was at its highest, 147869, at the end of 2021; the main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
